Regulation: B.C. Reg. 97/2026
Made under: Wildlife Act
Published in: No. 11 – B.C. Regs. 94 to 98, June 16, 2026
Deposit date: June 16, 2026

B.C. Reg. 97/2026, deposited June 16, 2026, under theWILDLIFE ACT[sections 108 and 109]. Ministerial Order M236/2026, dated June 15, 2026. I, Randene Neill, Minister of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship, order that, effective July 1, 2026, (a)	the Closed Areas Regulation, B.C. Reg. 76/84, is amended as set out in Appendix 1, (b)	the Designation and Exemption Regulation, B.C. Reg. 168/90, is amended as set out in Appendix 2, (c)	the Hunting Regulation, B.C. Reg. 190/84, is amended as set out in Appendix 3, (d)	the Limited Entry Hunting Regulation, B.C. Reg. 134/93, is amended as set out in Appendix 4, (e)	the Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulation, B.C. Reg. 18/2024, is amended as set out in Appendix 5, (f)	the Wildlife Act Commercial Activities Regulation, B.C. Reg. 338/82, is amended as set out in Appendix 6, and (g)	the Wildlife Act General Regulation, B.C. Reg. 340/82, is amended as set out in Appendix 7. — R. NEILL,Minister of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship. 1	The following section is added to the Closed Areas Regulation, B.C. Reg. 76/84: Conflict with otherWildlife Actregulations 1.1If there is a conflict between this regulation and another regulation made under the Act, this regulation prevails to the extent of the conflict. 2	Schedule 3 is amended by adding the following sections: 67That portion of M.U. 6‑25 that is outlined in red on the attached map ‘Closed Area No. 3‑67/26’. 68That portion of M.U. 7‑22 in the vicinity of Lower Burnt River Forest Service Road that is outlined in red on the attached map ‘Closed Area No. 3‑68/26’. 69That portion of the Province of British Columbia within 400 metres of the road allowance of Highway 113 between Sterling Mountain Parking Lot Recreation Site and Kincolith (Gingolx) and east to Nass Camp that is highlighted in yellow on the attached map ‘Closed Area No. 3‑69/26’. 3	Schedule 5 is amended by repealing section 28 (7) (d). 4	Schedule 9 is amended in section 22 (a)	by repealing paragraph (t) and substituting the following:

minutes_briefs.title: BC Wildlife Act regulations updated: new hunting closures and rule changes take effect July 1, 2026
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended seven regulations under the Wildlife Act, effective July 1, 2026. These changes add new closed areas for hunting (including areas near Highway 113 and the Lower Burnt River), adjust existing closures, and update rules across hunting, limited entry hunting, motor vehicle prohibitions, and commercial activities. The changes also clarify that the Closed Areas Regulation takes priority if it conflicts with other Wildlife Act regulations.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Review the new closed area maps and updated regulations to ensure your hunting or commercial activities comply starting July 1, 2026.

key_dates.label: BC Wildlife Act regulation amendments take effect
